title: Honeyed Malaysian Crepe Roti
description: A buttery, pillowy Malaysian crepe dessert filled with clotted cream, tempered chocolate, and a touch of honey.
instructions: Combine flour, sugar, and salt in a large mixing bowl.
In a separate bowl, whisk together egg, milk, and vegetable oil.
Gradually add the dry ingredients to the wet ingredients and mix until a smooth batter forms.
Heat a non-stick pan over medium heat and brush with butter.
Pour 1/4 cup of the batter into the pan and tilt to evenly coat the bottom.
Cook for 1-2 minutes or until the edges start to curl and the surface is dry.
Loosen the crepe with a spatula and flip it over.
Cook for another minute or until the other side is lightly browned.
Repeat with the remaining batter to make 8-10 crepes.
To assemble, spread a tablespoon of clotted cream on one half of each crepe, followed by a few dark chocolate chips.
Fold the crepe in half to enclose the filling and drizzle with honey.
Serve warm with additional clotted cream and chocolate chips if desired.
